latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video Gratis.
- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF files (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos for free.
- Automatic cloud GPU video rendering, with typical processing times of 30–60 seconds per video.
- Integrates free, anonymous token registration and session management for all users.
- Supports video editing actions via text commands, including transitions, background music, aspect ratio, and more.
- Export, credits checking, and session state handled through simple commands; all major workflows supported.
